brainlife.desc: Directory of cluster tables (CSV) from thresholded first-level fMRI GLM contrast maps.
brainlife.name: neuro/contrast-stats

original.desc: fMRI and other related contrast statistics

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Reporting peak and cluster statistics of single-subject task activation.

**Not for:** Group-level inference; tables are per run and per subject.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.contrast-stats.json

files.desc: Directory of CSV cluster tables, one per thresholded contrast map.

identifying_risks: Task activation can reveal cognitive responses of an individual
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Keep the task and events context with the data; share with participant codes only
tier_conditions: Tier 4 when combined into cognitive or behavioural profiles of a person

intended_use: Reporting peak and cluster statistics of single-subject task activation.
not_suitable_for: Group-level inference; tables are per run and per subject.
